pictures.observed: Garden view fromCafe5: pale framed glass facade, fine floor/vertical mullion grid, solid grey wall, lower projecting canopy and open garden. Historical garden reference guides surviving facade vocabulary; no copied sculptures, pools or trees.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Museum of Modern Art, New York: complete named mapped museum core and six integrated roof/body parts, with stepped white and grey gallery blocks, tall mapped west service block, dark 53rd Street facade and recessed glazed entry, thin projecting knife-edge canopy, pale vertical MoMA blade, garden-facing mullioned glazing/terrace and low western gallery-front cladding attached to the independently retained53W53 podium. Museum Tower/53W53 upper buildings, independent east brownstones, sculpture garden pools/trees/art and furnished interiors remain context.
